frames.code:
FUNCTION AGE_BY_ID(WANTED)
  DIM PERSON_ID(2)
  DIM PERSON_AGE(2)
  PERSON_ID(0) = 101
  PERSON_ID(1) = 205
  PERSON_ID(2) = 900
  PERSON_AGE(0) = 25
  PERSON_AGE(1) = 42
  PERSON_AGE(2) = 53
  AGE_BY_ID = -1
  FOR I = 0 TO 2
    IF (PERSON_ID(I) = WANTED) THEN
      AGE_BY_ID = PERSON_AGE(I)
    END IF
  NEXT I
  AGE_BY_ID = AGE_BY_ID
END FUNCTION
